result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and switches are unchecked.

- **Design rules:** The screen follows `DESIGN.md`. It sits on a white page, in one 1120px column, with a card for each section. All values come from the tokens, which I inlined because the file has to stand alone. The Danger zone has no red, and Delete Workspace is the outlined button.
- **Save Changes:** You asked for it inside the General section, so it's there as the single ink-filled button. The design file says the primary action goes in the top row beside the title. I kept the top row to the title only so the button isn't duplicated.
- **Switches:** The design file doesn't define switches, so I made my own. Email and Weekly summary start on, and Product updates starts off.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the screen will use the fallback fonts from the tokens.
